1.

Thus God loved the whole world That He gave forth His only Son, That whosoever believes on Him Shall have eternal life.

2.

For therein consists the love, Not that we have loved God, But therein that He loved us And gave us His Son.

3.

Yea, therein is God’s love great Which was made manifest to us, That for atonement for all our sin He has sent His Son.

4.

He has sent us Jesus Christ, That on Him we should believe, That through Him we may live And love for His sake.
